ShareToken 是开源权重模型的 P2P 共享网络。闲时共享算力赚 cre: ShareToken is a P2P sharing network for open-weight models. Share idle compute to earn credit, and call other people's nodes over the OpenAI protocol when you need them. Requests are end-to-end encrypted, responses carry signed receipts, and overstated usage is refunded on evidence.
一单一钥：拿证据退款，只暴露这一单: One job, one key: get a refund with evidence, exposing only that job

不靠信任平台，靠密码学。: Rely on cryptography, not on trusting a platform.

协调器负责撮合和记账，不在这条路径上: The coordinator handles matching and accounting, and is not on this path

只转发密文，不记账: Forwards ciphertext only, keeps no accounts
同一个账户，既能卖也能买。: One account to both sell and buy.

哈希不一致 → 买家拒签，可凭证据发起争议: Hashes differ → the buyer refuses to sign and can dispute with evidence
它伪造不了收据和 Ack，但账本由它记录。: It cannot forge receipts or Acks, but it is the one keeping the ledger.
它让作弊长期不划算，但不保证每一单都被查到。: They make cheating unprofitable over time, but do not guarantee that every job gets checked.
客户端在本地开一个 OpenAI 兼容端点。任何支持 OpenAI 协议的工具，: The client opens a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Any tool that speaks the OpenAI protocol works once you change its base URL.
每次用发到邮箱的验证码登录，没有密码可被撞库或泄露。验证码和登录失败都限流。人人: You sign in each time with a code sent to your email, so there is no password to stuff or leak. Codes and failed sign-ins are rate limited. Anyone can turn on TOTP two-factor authentication; admins must.

开源权重模型的 P2P 共享网络: A P2P sharing network for open-weight models
开源权重模型的 P2P 共享网络：端到端加密、签名收据、证据裁决。: A P2P sharing network for open-weight models: end-to-end encryption, signed receipts, evidence-based disputes.
把本机 Ollama 里的模型共享出去。不需要公网 IP，节点经中继打通连接；买: Share a model from your local Ollama. No public IP needed: nodes connect through relays, and when buyer and seller both turn direct tunnels on, traffic flows straight between the two.
把机器上的模型接入网络，闲时赚 credit，要用时按 OpenAI 协议调用别: Connect the models on your machine to the network and earn credit while idle. When you need compute, call other people's nodes over the OpenAI protocol. Only the target node can open a request, and every response carries the node's signature.
撮合、结算、争议和抽检。不监听任何端口，只能经中继访问，暴露面很小。: Matching, settlement, disputes and audits. It listens on no ports and is reachable only through relays, so its exposure is small.
收件钥只存在于机密虚拟机内，节点运营者也读不到内存: The recipient key exists only inside the confidential VM, and even the node operator cannot read its memory
有多个，只转发加密流量。读不到明文，不记账，只给持有效凭证的设备预约。: There are several, and they forward only encrypted traffic. They cannot read plaintext, keep no accounts, and accept reservations only from devices with a valid pass.
核对收据里的两个哈希: Check the two hashes in the receipt
每条消息都生成新的临时密钥，用节点在签名 Offer 里公布的公钥协商出一次性的: Each message generates a new ephemeral key and uses the public key the node published in its signed Offer to agree on a one-time symmetric key. Ciphertext is also bound to the job ID and sequence number, so it cannot be replayed into another job or reordered in a stream.
注册登录、API token、设备绑定、账单和中继登记，就是你现在看到的这个网站: Sign-up and login, API tokens, device binding, bills and relay registration. It's the website you're looking at now.
演示：一组作业中只有发生争议的一单被解开，裁决方重新计数后退款，其它作业保持加密: Demo: in a set of jobs, only the disputed job is opened. The arbiter recounts and refunds, and all other jobs stay encrypted.
演示：买家的 prompt 加密后经过中继，中继只能看到密文，到达目标节点后才被: Demo: the buyer's prompt is encrypted and passes through a relay that sees only ciphertext. It is decrypted only on reaching the target node. The coordinator is not on the data path.
点下面任意一块响应，亲手篡改它。哈希是浏览器现场用 SHA-256 算的。: Click any response chunk below to tamper with it yourself. Your browser computes the hash live with SHA-256.
签名收据：改一个字，整份作废: Signed receipts: change one character and the whole receipt is void
网络里的每一方都是一个 Ed25519 身份。谁发了什么、签了什么，都可以离线验: Every party on the network is an Ed25519 identity. Who sent and signed what can be verified offline.
节点用 Ed25519 签下请求和响应的哈希、模型和用量。买家不看节点怎么说，自: The node uses Ed25519 to sign the request and response hashes, the model and the usage. The buyer doesn't take the node's word for it and recomputes what it received. A node that signs one thing and delivers another is caught on the spot.
节点虚报用量时，买家拒签，并交出<strong>这一单</strong>的密钥作: When a node overstates usage, the buyer refuses to sign and hands over the key of this one job as evidence. The arbiter checks the receipt, decrypts the response, recounts the tokens with a reference model and rules automatically. Every other job has its own key, and nobody can open those.
解密响应，用参考模型重新计数: Decrypt the response and recount with a reference model
计费按 Ticket 上的价格结算，不超过预留金额。复式账本启动时回放日志对账。: Billing settles at the Ticket's price and never exceeds the reserved amount. The double-entry ledger replays its log to reconcile at startup.
中继节点分布在北美、欧洲和亚洲: Relay nodes in North America, Europe and Asia
转发流量的看不到内容，记账的不碰数据路径，管账户的不撮合交易。: Whoever forwards traffic can't see content, whoever keeps accounts stays off the data path, and whoever manages accounts doesn't match trades.
运行模型就必须解密，运营者理论上能读到: Running a model requires decryption, so the operator can in principle read it
量子隧穿|是指波子|不能穿过|经典力学|下可以|越过的势垒: Quantum tunneling|means waves|cannot pass through|barriers that classical physics|says they can|never cross
量子隧穿|是指粒子|能穿过|经典力学|下无法|越过的势垒: Quantum tunneling|means particles|can pass through|barriers that classical physics|says they could|never cross
门户签发 1 小时有效的 Ed25519 凭证，写明设备 peer ID。凭证被: The portal issues Ed25519 passes valid for 1 hour, naming the device's peer ID. A stolen pass is useless.
非流式响应在收据验证通过后才交给你；流式响应边到边转发，结尾附验证结果。: Non-streaming responses reach you only after the receipt verifies. Streaming responses are forwarded as they arrive, with the verification result at the end.

本地 OpenAI 兼容端点，支持 OpenAI 协议的工具改一下 base U: A local OpenAI-compatible endpoint: tools that speak the OpenAI protocol only need a new base URL.
节点不需要公网 IP，经中继打通连接；自动测 RTT 选最快的中继，故障时自动切: Nodes need no public IP and connect through relays. The client measures RTT to pick the fastest relay and switches automatically when one fails.
接入在模型厂商开通的 API key 或订阅服务对外共享，买家可以用 Anthr: Share the API keys or subscriptions you have with model providers. Buyers call them in the Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini message format or over the OpenAI-compatible protocol.
请求封装加密，只有目标节点打得开，中继和协调器都看不到。: Requests are sealed so that only the target node can open them. Relays and the coordinator cannot see them.
响应带节点的 Ed25519 签名收据，买家自己核对，内容被改动会被发现。: Responses carry the node's Ed25519-signed receipt. Buyers check it themselves, so altered content is detected.
节点虚报用量时，买家只交出这一单的密钥作为证据，裁决后自动退款。: When a node over-reports usage, the buyer hands over the key of that one job as evidence and is refunded automatically after the ruling.
协调器随机抽检，检查节点有没有偷换模型。抽检是概率性的。: The coordinator audits nodes at random to check that they have not swapped the model. Audits are probabilistic.
普通节点的运营者能读到 prompt，需要排除运营者时可以选 TEE 节点（AM: Operators of ordinary nodes can read prompts. To exclude the operator, choose TEE nodes (AMD SEV-SNP / Intel TDX).
卖家生成配对码发给买家；买家配对后只向配对的卖家购买，最多同时配对三个卖家。: A seller creates a pairing code and gives it to buyers. A paired buyer buys only from its paired sellers, up to three at a time.
配对码有效期可选 1 天、7 天或 30 天，可以限制使用人数，随时撤销；买卖双: A pairing code lasts 1, 7 or 30 days, can be limited to a number of buyers and can be revoked at any time. Either side can end a pairing.
私有模式：开启后卖家只为配对的买家服务，其他人看不到它的模型。: Private mode: when it is on, the seller serves only its paired buyers and nobody else sees its models.
桌面应用、命令行和用户页面都能管理配对。: Pairing can be managed in the desktop app, on the command line and on the user page.
命令行客户端，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。: Command-line client for macOS, Linux and Windows.
带图形界面的桌面应用，提供 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 安装包。: Desktop app with a graphical interface, with installers for macOS, Linux and Windows.
网站和用户页面支持 10 种语言，桌面客户端支持英文和简体中文。: The website and user page are available in 10 languages; the desktop client in English and Simplified Chinese.
有新版本时，桌面应用和命令行会提醒更新。: The desktop app and the command line tell you when a new version is available.
本机模型和厂商 API，都能共享。: Share local models and provider APIs alike.
接入你在模型厂商开通的 API key 或订阅服务。买家即可用 API key: Connect the API keys or subscriptions you have with model providers. Buyers can then call with an API key, with native support for the Anthropic, OpenAI and Gemini message formats and the OpenAI-compatible protocol.

请求以明文发给厂商，用量记在你的厂商账户上。共享前请确认厂商的服务条款允许这样使: Requests go to the provider in plaintext, and usage is charged to your account with the provider. Before sharing, check that the provider's terms of service allow this use.
生成配对码发给你的买家，他们的请求只会发给和自己配对的卖家。开启私有模式后，你只: Create a pairing code and give it to your buyers: their requests then go only to the sellers they are paired with. Turn on private mode and you serve only your paired buyers.

配对由协调器在撮合时执行，改客户端绕不过去。桌面应用和门户里也能操作。: The coordinator applies pairing when it matches requests, so a modified client cannot get around it. The desktop app and the portal offer the same.
配对成为共享伙伴后，双方可以共享对方的 token 资源；伙伴节点不可用时，自动: Once paired as share partners, each of you can use the other's token resources; when a partner's nodes are unavailable, requests switch back to the P2P network automatically.
可以限制给出去的量：每 24 小时最多给多少 tokens，以及伙伴最多占每个节: Limit what you give: the most tokens per 24 hours, and how much of each node's concurrency partners may take. A share of 0 pauses sharing.
「只用伙伴的节点」：开启后不再到网络上购买。: "Partners' nodes only": when on, nothing is bought on the network.
最多 5 个伙伴。邀请码只能用一次，有效期 1 到 7 天。: Up to 5 partners. An invite code works once and lasts 1 to 7 days.
入口：桌面应用「配对 → 共享伙伴」，或命令行 sharetoken partn: Where: Pairing → Share partners in the desktop app, or sharetoken partner on the command line.
不再使用密码：输入邮箱和收到的验证码即可登录，新邮箱会自动注册。: No more passwords: enter your email and the code sent to it to sign in; a new address gets an account.
可以开启两步验证，管理员必须开启。: Two-factor authentication can be turned on, and administrators must turn it on.
收不到验证码时，可以写信给支持邮箱，由管理员提供一次性验证码。: If the code does not arrive, write to the support address and an administrator can give you a one-time code.
新界面：升级到 Wails v3，窗口更小，带侧边栏导航，底部状态栏显示连接状态: New look: now on Wails v3, with a smaller window, a sidebar and a status bar showing the connection, the relay and its latency.
菜单栏显示当前中继、延迟、共享状态和可用 credit。: The menu bar shows the relay in use, its latency, sharing and your available credit.
Linux 支持托盘图标（需要 Ubuntu 24.04 或 Debian 13: Tray icon on Linux (needs Ubuntu 24.04 or Debian 13 or later).
一键升级：有新版本时点「立即更新」就能下载安装，安装包会先校验发布签名。命令行用: One-click update: when a new version is out, click "Update now" to download and install it; the package's release signature is checked first. On the command line: sharetoken upgrade.
本机的管理接口需要密钥才能访问；桌面应用连接后台程序前，会先确认对方的身份。: The local management API needs a key, and the desktop app confirms the background program's identity before connecting to it.
本地 OpenAI 兼容端点默认需要 API key（sk-st-…）。可以在设: The local OpenAI-compatible endpoint needs an API key by default (sk-st-…). View, change or turn it off in Settings or with sharetoken apikey.
回答改用压缩后的二进制帧传输，经中继的流量降到原来的约 1/8；模型出字越快，省: Answers travel in compressed binary frames: traffic through relays drops to about 1/8, and the faster a model writes, the more it saves.
请求先压缩再发送，长对话历史的上传量降到约 1/4，大请求的首字更快。: Requests are compressed before they are sent: uploading a long conversation history takes about 1/4 of the traffic, and large requests get their first token sooner.
请求上限从 4 MB 提高到 32 MB，可以带截图等图片。: The request limit rises from 4 MB to 32 MB, so requests can carry images such as screenshots.
同一段对话的后续请求优先回到上次的节点：连接已经建好，模型服务器的 prompt: Later requests of one conversation go back to the node that served it last: the connection is already open and the model server's prompt cache is more likely to hit.
中继重启或网络切换时，正在输出的回答会在 60 秒内自动接上，不需要重发请求。: When a relay restarts or the network changes, an answer that is being written resumes automatically within 60 seconds, without sending the request again.
模型长时间思考时，节点每 10 秒发一次心跳，不再被误判为卡死；买家的超时默认值: While a model thinks for a long time, the node sends a heartbeat every 10 seconds, so the job is no longer mistaken for stuck. The buyer's timeouts now default to 30 seconds.
点停止后，节点立即停止生成，只按已送达的部分计费。: After you press stop, the node stops generating at once, and you pay only for the part delivered.
回答合并发送并补齐长度，请求按区间补齐，中继无法再从数据包大小推测每个 toke: Answers are sent in merged, padded frames and requests are padded to size buckets, so relays can no longer infer the length of each token from packet sizes.
本地端点同时提供 OpenAI Chat Completions、Anthrop: The local endpoint speaks three APIs: OpenAI Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages and OpenAI Responses, so Claude Code and Codex work with it directly. A seller whose model server speaks the request's API passes it on unchanged; others convert it.
私有中继：可以部署自己的中继，只为你列出的账号服务，别人访问你共享的设备时走你自: Private relays: run a relay of your own that serves only the accounts you list, so that the devices you share from are reached through your own server. The guide has the relay program for Linux and the steps.
从 prompt 缓存读出和写入缓存的 token 单独计价；每个请求的预算默认: Tokens read from and written to the prompt cache have prices of their own. The budget per request is 2 credits by default and can be changed in the desktop app's settings, where you can also choose to buy only from sellers that speak the request's API natively.
三种接口之间的转换更完整：并行工具调用、结构化输出、思考设置、工具返回的图片和缓: Conversion between the three APIs is more complete: parallel tool calls, structured output, thinking settings, images returned by tools and cache usage all survive the round trip.
模型服务临时出错（过载、5xx、连接中断）时自动重试；额度用完或登录失效的提供商: Temporary failures of a model server (overload, 5xx, a broken connection) are retried. A provider that ran out of quota or whose login expired stops taking jobs instead of failing them one by one.
模型服务的回答中途断开时按失败处理，不再当作完整回答计费。: An answer that the model server cut off midway counts as failed and is no longer billed as complete.
平台抽检可以由用户的客户端转交：请求和回答全程加密，转交的客户端看不到内容，也不: Spot checks can be carried by users' clients: the request and the answer stay encrypted, the carrying client cannot read them and pays nothing, and the seller cannot tell a check from a real request. On by default; the configuration file turns it off.
抽检覆盖三种接口，由参考模型逐 token 核对卖家的回答。: Spot checks cover all three APIs, and a reference model checks the seller's answer token by token.
卖家节点不再执行买家请求里的托管工具；买家带来的请求头和 beta 开关按卖家的: Seller nodes no longer run hosted tools named in a buyer's request, and the headers and beta switches a buyer sends are filtered by the kind of account the seller uses.
运行 sharetoken models -codex 生成模型目录文件并在 C: After sharetoken models -codex writes a model catalog file and Codex's configuration names it, Codex knows the real context window and reasoning levels of the network's models and compacts conversations in time.
本地端点在 HTTP 上也支持 previous_response_id，Ope: The local endpoint also answers previous_response_id over HTTP, so tools such as the OpenAI Agents SDK work with it directly, and a Codex WebSocket session can be interrupted midway.
循环检测：模型原地重复输出，或反复调用同一个工具得到相同结果时自动截断，不再白白: Loop guard: an answer that repeats itself in place, or the same tool call returning the same result again and again, is cut short instead of spending credits for nothing. On by default; the configuration file turns it off.
Codex 走 HTTP 时，任务完成后立即结算，不再等待 24 小时的争议期。: Codex over HTTP settles a job as soon as it finishes instead of waiting out the 24-hour dispute window.
上下文超长时按各客户端能识别的方式回报，Claude Code 和 Codex: A conversation that grows too long is reported the way each client understands, so Claude Code and Codex compact it and carry on.
修复网络接口不可达时整个 QUIC 连接被关闭的问题；卖家刚开始回答就出错、或连: An unreachable network interface no longer closes every QUIC connection. A seller failing right at the start of an answer, or a broken connection, is retried on another node, and heartbeats keep slow models connected.
与 Claude、Codex、Gemini 和各类 OpenAI 兼容服务的兼容: Better compatibility with Claude, Codex, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible servers: request shapes a server refuses are corrected and remembered, and tool call pairing, image sizes, thinking settings and tool schemas follow what each server requires.
单个请求超出卖家的每分钟额度时只让这个请求失败，不再让卖家暂停对所有买家的服务。: A single request larger than a seller's per-minute allowance fails on its own instead of pausing that seller for every buyer.
买家在 chat 请求里填写的 user 标识不再转发给卖家的模型服务。: The user identifier a buyer puts in a chat request is no longer passed on to the seller's model server.
直连隧道：买卖双方都在路由器后面、无法直接相连时，可以经一条基于 Tailsca: Direct tunnels: when buyer and seller are both behind routers and cannot connect directly, they can now reach each other through an encrypted tunnel built on Tailscale's protocol (WireGuard), so requests and answers no longer pass through a relay. No Tailscale account, system VPN or administrator rights needed. Off by default: turn it on with sharetoken tailnet on or the switch in the desktop app; it works when both sides have it on, and when a tunnel cannot be set up, requests go through the relay as before.
隧道里的连接默认使用 QUIC，网络稳定时上传几 MB 的大请求明显更快；网络丢: Inside a tunnel the connection uses QUIC by default, which uploads requests of several megabytes clearly faster on a steady network; on a link that loses packets or jitters (weak Wi-Fi, for example) it can be slower instead, and you can switch to TCP (sharetoken tailnet on -transport tcp).
桌面应用的设置新增“网络”页：开关直连隧道，设置传输协议、等待时间和中转服务器，: The desktop app's settings have a new "Network" tab: turn direct tunnels on or off, set the transport, the wait and the DERP relays, and see each tunnel's path, transport, latency and traffic. The status bar shows how the tunnels are connected right now and their latency.
同一个公网地址后面可以有更多设备：中继和协调器对每个地址接受的连接数从 8 条提: More devices fit behind one public address: relays and the coordinator now accept 32 connections per address, up from 8, so no device is left unable to reach a relay when an office or a home shares one address.
第一次连接卖家更快：卖家的地址里有连不上的内网地址时，不再拖住经中继的连接，此前: The first connection to a seller is faster: unreachable private addresses among a seller's addresses no longer hold up the connection through the relay, which used to cost about 10 extra seconds now and then.
预热：Claude 和 ChatGPT（Codex）订阅的 5 小时窗口从重置后: Warm-up: a Claude or ChatGPT (Codex) subscription's 5-hour window starts at the first request after it resets. The client can send one tiny request at times you choose, so a window starts early and resets sooner while you work. It works for the Claude Code and Codex on this computer and for the Claude and ChatGPT logins you sell, and nothing goes through the ShareToken network. Set it under Settings → Warm-up in the desktop app, or with sharetoken warmup.
“共享”页的厂商卡片显示 Claude 和 ChatGPT 登录的用量窗口和预热: The provider cards on the Sharing page show the usage windows and the warm-up of Claude and ChatGPT logins.
经中继的连接不再算在中继的地址上：协调器同时在线的用户数，以及经中继接单的卖家同: Connections through a relay no longer count against the relay's address: the users online at the coordinator, and the buyers a seller serves through a relay, are no longer capped at 32 connections per relay (8 for a seller).
增加ShareToken Cli端的Skill，可使用sharetoken sk: A skill for the ShareToken CLI, installed with sharetoken skill install, lets AI agents such as Codex and Claude operate it directly.

邀请链接：配对码和共享伙伴邀请码都附带一个链接，对方还没装客户端也能打开：页面显: Invite links: every pairing code and share-partner invite comes with a link that works even before the app is installed. Its page shows who invites; sign in or sign up with an email address, accept with one click, then download the app as the page suggests. With the app already installed, the page opens it to confirm.
“需要我确认”：生成配对码或伙伴邀请时可以勾选，对方使用后要你确认才生效。: “Require my approval”: tick it when making a pairing code or partner invite, and a use takes effect only once you approve it.
网页控制台的配对页也能管理共享伙伴，并能复制链接和整段邀请文案。: The web console’s pairing page also manages share partners, and copies links and ready-made invitation messages.
配对码加长到 10 位，链接是另外的 12 位令牌；输错的配对码和链接按账户、地: Pairing codes are now 10 characters, and links carry a separate 12-character token. Wrong codes and links are counted per account, per address and per day, new accounts get fewer tries, and when many come in from everywhere the limits tighten and the administrators are told.
